name: Plugsera Bulkrify – Bulk Editor for WooCommerce
author: plugsera

sections.description:
Plugsera Bulkrify – Bulk Editor for WooCommerce helps store owners save time by allowing quick and reliable bulk edits of WooCommerce products directly from the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin focuses on simplicity, performance, and safety while following WordPress.org best practices.

Key Features

  • Search WooCommerce products instantly
  • Select multiple products at once
  • Bulk edit product data including:
    • Product title
    • SKU
    • Regular price
    • Sale price
    • Stock quantity
    • Stock status
  • Bulk delete products
  • Clean, modern admin interface
  • Works seamlessly with WooCommerce

Bulkrify is designed to work out of the box without any license keys, subscriptions, or external services.

Optional Premium Version

Bulkrify Pro is a separate premium plugin that offers additional advanced tools for store owners who need more complex workflows or are managing very large catalogs.

The free version of Bulkrify is fully functional on its own and does not require any payment or license to use.

Learn more:
https://sites.google.com/view/bulkrify/home

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to Dashboard → Bulkrify
sections.faq:
Does Plugsera Bulkrify require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does the plugin require a license key?

No. The free version works without any license or activation.

Will the plugin stop working after some time?

No. The plugin does not expire.

Is there a premium version available?

Yes. Bulkrify Pro is offered as a separate plugin with additional features.
